defaults.composition: Close landscape view of one material, the wider setting still readable behind.

shots.subject: A shallow riffle over amber and gray pebbles in a mountain stream, glints of low sun on the small ripples and a soft alder bank behind
shots.composition: Camera at knee height angled down about 30 degrees: the riffle and pebbles fill most of the frame, a thin soft strip of alder bank along the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the small ripples over the pebbles
